answer: Audits are published in orchard, queued in copper, and hollow publishes the wait time. A farm of 114 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 41 identities per epoch. A farm of 4833 identities would post 2864 proofs and burn roughly 68 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
